title: Smash and Grab
description: Smash-and-grab video is impact as coverage: glass, snatch, handheld chaos, a theft of a moment. The camera is inside the crime, too close and too late.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: A pane goes. A hand already leaves.
Flash or streetlight strobes the shards. Use it when the scene is a robbery of time: heist, paparazzi, panic, joining at the worst second.
It is the wrong tool for a planned fight with clear axes, and for documentary breathing on a still interview. If the smash is only in the edit, you want a crash cut.
If the operator is simply present in a quiet room, you want handheld.

sections.title: How it works

blocks.text: Put the camera in the way: handheld, short lens, glass as foreground flying toward the taking glass. One impact, then escape.
Motion smear is allowed. Pretty centering is not.
A hard flash or a practical strobe can freeze a shard. Keep the snatched object or the broken pane in frame.
Prompt smash-and-grab energy: glass, impact, snatch, handheld chaos. For video, violent handheld smash, impact, grab, escape.

sections.title: What usually goes wrong

blocks.text: The usual wrong cousin is a posed action still or polite Handheld. The tell is a wide shop, a centered fighter, no glass toward camera.
The fix is dirty edges, shards at the lens, a hand already leaving.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is smash and grab in film?
Smash and grab is coverage as a robbery: glass, impact, snatch, handheld chaos. The camera is inside the crime, a theft of a moment.
Smash and grab vs handheld
Handheld can be a breathing hold on a still scene. Smash and grab is impact: shards, a snatch, an escape. One is presence. The other is a theft.
When should I use smash and grab?
Use it when we join at the worst second: heist, panic, paparazzi. Skip it for a clean fight or a quiet interview.
How do I prompt smash and grab for AI image or video?
Write Smash-and-grab energy on [Subject], glass, impact, snatch, handheld chaos. For video, violent handheld smash, grab, escape. Put shards toward the lens and name what is taken.
